mapper.sql: WHERE b.board_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND b.board_type_cd = #{boardTypeCd} AND b.board_ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_sq AS sq, b.user_sq AS userSq, u.user_nm AS userNm, b.board_ttl AS ttl, b.board_view_cnt AS viewCnt, b.board_comment_cnt AS commentCnt, b.board_recommend_cnt AS recommendCnt, b.board_created_at_dtm AS createdAt, b.board_adopt_status_cd AS boardAdoptStatusCd, 0 AS answerCnt FROM TBL_BOARD_M b LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON b.user_sq = u.user_sq ORDER BY b.board_sq b.board_ttl b.board_view_cnt b.board_recommend_cnt b.board_created_at_dtm b.board_created_at_dtm ${sortOrder} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_BOARD_COMMENT_S SET comment_is_deleted_yn = 'Y', comment_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE comment_sq = #{commentSq}
